da39714a260413ea.description: About the Role Finstorm Placement Services is recruiting on behalf of a prominent manufacturer of HDPE, Pre-Insulated Piping Systems, Fittings, Valves, and Infrastructure Solutions in Saudi Arabia. We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for maintaining and improving quality and safety management systems within manufacturing operations. This role involves ensuring compliance with project specifications and industry standards, supporting product approvals, and coordinating various audits and certifications. The position offers exposure to significant infrastructure, water, utility, and district cooling projects across the region. Key Responsibilities Maintain and continuously improve Quality Management and Occupational Health & Safety Management Systems. Prepare and manage SOPs, ITPs, Quality Plans, Method Statements, and quality documentation. Review raw material and finished product inspection records to ensure compliance with project specifications and applicable standards. Conduct internal audits, risk assessments, management reviews, and training programs. Coordinate external audits and certifications, including ISO, SASO, NSF, FM, NWC, and Aramco approvals. Support product testing, third-party inspections, and customer approval processes. Liaise with clients, consultants, certification bodies, production teams, and sales teams on quality and compliance matters. Monitor laboratory testing activities and calibration schedules across manufacturing operations. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience as a QA/QC Engineer. Demonstrated ability to manage quality management systems and ensure compliance with standards. Experience with relevant certifications and approvals (*, ISO, SASO, NSF, FM, NWC, Aramco). Impact of the Role This position contributes to driving quality excellence, securing critical product approvals, and supporting international certifications. The QA/QC Engineer will play a key part in delivering industry-leading solutions for demanding projects within the Kingdom. Application Process Interested candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

da155356619b6afb.description: About Saudi Gold Refinery Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is a Saudi mining and precious-metals company specializing in the refining of gold and precious metals, bullion production, and value-added precious-metal services. Operating within the Kingdom’s mining value chain, SGR aligns with the Vision 2030 mining pillar and the regulatory framework set by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM), adhering to applicable Saudi and international standards. The company produces responsibly sourced, traceable, and certified bullion, operates to LBMA Good Delivery and ISO-aligned quality standards, and invests in the people, processes, and controls behind its products. Role Overview: Supply Chain Manager Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is seeking a Supply Chain Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing procurement, logistics, and warehouse operations. The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for optimizing inventory levels for critical chemicals and spare parts to ensure continuous company operations. The position requires a disciplined approach to vendor management and risk mitigation within a highly regulated environment, reporting directly to the CEO. This role is crucial for safeguarding the integrity of material flows and driving efficiency in sourcing and logistics, while maintaining strict adherence to anti-money-laundering and due diligence protocols. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement sourcing strategies for dore bars and industrial chemicals to ensure cost-effective and reliable supply. Manage armored transport contracts and coordinate with Saudi Customs for the import and export of high-value goods. Oversee monthly reconciliations of precious metal inventories and optimize stock levels for maintenance spares. Evaluate supplier performance and conduct audits to verify ethical sourcing and financial stability. Implement digital tracking tools to enhance visibility and traceability across the entire supply chain. Lead the supply chain team by setting clear performance goals and providing technical training on compliance protocols. Identify potential supply disruptions and develop contingency plans to maintain operational continuity. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in supply chain management, preferably within a highly regulated industry. The role requires a strong understanding of procurement, logistics, inventory control, and vendor management. Success Metrics for this Role Achieve monthly inventory reconciliation accuracy exceeding 98%. Decrease procurement lead times for critical chemicals by 15%. Successfully implement end-to-end digital tracking for metal flows. Realize a five percent cost reduction in indirect material spend. Establish qualified backup suppliers for all critical inputs. Ensure full compliance with KYC and AML checks for all new vendors. Equal Opportunity Statement Saudi Gold Refinery welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Hiring decisions are made based on role requirements, skills, experience, and alignment with Saudization and Vision 2030 priorities.

da8cd41a6c5c26cd.description: About Roche and the Role At Roche, individuals are valued for their unique contributions, fostering a culture that encourages personal expression and open dialogue. This approach supports the company's mission to prevent, stop, and cure diseases, ensuring access to healthcare. This full-time role for an Omnichannel & Marketing Enabler Multiple Sclerosis is based in Riyadh and requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Marketing & Omnichannel Enabler - Multiple Sclerosis for the Middle East is responsible for developing and implementing customer- and patient-centric commercial strategies. This includes marketing, brand management, and customer engagement for the assigned disease area across the Middle East region. The role integrates market insights, omnichannel engagement, and product strategies to achieve impactful, patient-centered outcomes. Approximately 80% of this role focuses on Middle East countries, collaborating with Disease Area Squads, ME affiliate POCs, the Disease Commercialization Leader (DCL), Patient Journey Partners (PJPs), Medical, Access, and Informatics teams. The remaining 20% is dedicated to local affiliate or chapter activities to maintain local relevance. Key Responsibilities Partner with the DCL and Disease Area Squads to implement global brand and portfolio strategies (DACS & CORP), ensuring alignment with business outcomes and patient needs. Conduct market analysis and competitive landscaping to inform brand positioning and identify market opportunities. Lead the execution of global segmentation, targeting, and positioning strategies, developing value propositions for healthcare solutions. Collaborate with the DCL and ME affiliates to support launch readiness planning, tactical execution, and performance tracking for Malignant Hematology and related initiatives. Lead the localization and execution of global communication strategies for campaigns, events, and content assets, ensuring scientific accuracy and market relevance. Contribute to the across-affiliate Disease Area financial ambition, ensuring optimal investment planning in collaboration with affiliate teams, finance, and the DCL. Additional Duties Design and execute disease area-specific promotional plans and integrated customer experiences by leveraging customer segmentation, persona development, and personalized targeting in collaboration with PJPs and customer-facing teams. Identify and manage compelling and modular content needs (promotional & non-promotional) tailored for different audiences, channels, and formats, in close collaboration with internal and external partners, adhering to brand guidelines, compliance/regulatory requirements, and MLR processes. Ensure omnichannel initiatives are designed and driven by identified cross-country needs, delivering seamless integration between scientific engagement and marketing campaigns. Identify and regularly work with appropriate internal and external resources, including contracting with agencies and vendors. Experience Required 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, operating within a collaborative environment that values individual contributions and fosters professional growth.

da93f1f41b96b50c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشغل فن شروق للتزيين النسائي عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتضمن هذا الدور استقبال الزوار والعملاء، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتوجيههم إلى الأقسام المختصة. كما يشمل الدور التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية وإدارة عمليات الفوترة والدفع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية، والترحيب بهم، وتحديد مطالبهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إصدار الفواتير الخاصة بالخدمات المطلوبة وإتمام عمليات الدفع، سواء كانت نقدية أو إلكترونية أو بالتقسيط. الالتزام التام بمواعيد العمل المحددة والجدية في الأداء. إقفال الورديات وتسليمها للمشرفة المسؤولة خلال مدة أقصاها 48 ساعة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في تنظيم المهام وإدارة الوقت. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزامًا كاملًا بساعات العمل المحددة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

daea19085ae2d004.description: About the Role Office Solutions, a Dubai-based flooring company specializing in solutions for commercial, residential, and interior fit-out projects, is seeking a Business Development Executive. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on expanding the company's market presence and developing new business opportunities within the region. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Saudi Arabian construction and interior fit-out market. Establish relationships with main contractors, flooring contractors, consultants, developers, architects, and procurement teams. Generate project leads and identify upcoming projects at an early stage. Promote the company's flooring products and solutions, including raised access flooring and other relevant flooring systems. Arrange client meetings, product presentations, and technical discussions. Coordinate with the estimation and technical teams to prepare quotations, proposals, and submittals. Follow up on tenders, quotations, negotiations, and project awards. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and potential business opportunities. Achieve assigned sales targets and maintain an updated sales pipeline and CRM records. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Good understanding of project sales, tendering, and the construction project cycle. Strong communication, negotiation, and client relationship skills. Willingness to travel within Saudi Arabia for client meetings and project visits. Valid Saudi work authorization or eligibility to work in KSA. A valid driving license is required. Compensation The salary for this position ranges from SAR 7,500 to SAR 11,250, complemented by performance-based incentives. Career Development This role offers the opportunity to develop the company's presence in a growing market, with direct exposure to major construction and interior fit-out projects. Career growth is based on business performance.

da7ac92bb1ffea18.description: **Architect – Project Manager Required** The company announces its need for an **Architect to fill the position of Project Manager** to work in the city of **Dammam – Saudi Arabia**, according to the following conditions: **Job Requirements:** - Bachelor’s degree in Architecture. - At least **10 years** of practical experience in project management and execution. - **Proven track record in hospital and healthcare facility projects**. - Experience in managing teams and coordinating between architectural, structural, and electromechanical (MEP) disciplines. - Ability to monitor site execution, quality control, scheduling, and costs. - Proficiency in reading and reviewing blueprints and technical specifications, and coordinating with the consultant and the owner. - Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the ability to solve problems and make decisions. **Work Location:** Dammam – Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. **To Apply:** Please send your CV attached with a brief list of previous projects, highlighting the hospital projects that have been managed or executed. **Priority will be given to candidates with direct experience in managing hospital projects.**

da01b30ad4314406.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأطعمة الفاخرة عن نادل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم تجربة مميزة للعملاء من خلال استقبالهم وتلبية طلباتهم بكفاءة واحترافية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتزويدهم بقوائم الأطعمة والمشروبات، مع تلقي الطلبات وتقديمها. الإجابة عن استفسارات العملاء وتقديم المشورة بشأن خيارات الأطعمة والمشروبات المتاحة. إعداد الطاولات وترتيبها وتنظيفها، بما في ذلك ترتيب الأطباق والأواني وإعادتها إلى أماكنها المخصصة. تقديم الفواتير للعملاء واستلام وتسجيل المدفوعات النقدية، بالإضافة إلى استخدام آلات نقاط البيع. التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء ورفعها إلى المسؤول المختص لاتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الضيافة أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بلباقة. بيئة العمل يعمل النادل ضمن فريق خدمة العملاء في أحد مطاعم شركة الأطعمة الفاخرة في الدمام. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان تقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء. طبيعة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتقديم الخدمات المباشرة للعملاء. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة الأطعمة الفاخرة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

da07cf56c165abb5.description: Core Responsibilities Sample Handling: Receive, label, sort, store, and prepare biological, chemical, or industrial samples. Testing & Analysis: Perform routine and specialized analyses, operate automated systems, microscopes, or spectrometers, and record accurate data. Equipment Maintenance: Set up, clean, sterilize, calibrate, and troubleshoot lab instruments and logbooks. Safety & Compliance: Follow strict Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (QHSE) guidelines, handle biohazards or chemical waste properly, and maintain SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures). Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels, order lab supplies, and manage glassware or reagents.

da4a59124850e229.description: About the Role Ethra For Human Resources Consulting is seeking an Executive Operations Director to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting the CEO in managing executive priorities and coordinating shared services across various functions, including IT, Finance, and Legal. The position focuses on overseeing relationships with outsourced service providers and monitoring contract performance to ensure operational efficiency and effective cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities Prepare concise briefings for the CEO, outlining facts, assumptions, options, risks, recommendations, and required decisions. Maintain a confidential decision log and confirm decisions with authorized decision-makers before communication. Draft CEO correspondence, talking points, and internal announcements for approval. Manage the management rhythm, including agendas, briefing materials, meeting records, action owners, deadlines, and follow-up. Coordinate with fractional leadership functions (finance, information security, compliance) and specialists, respecting their reporting lines. Follow up on management decisions until closure and report overdue actions to the CEO. Track contracted deliverables, recurring obligations, required inputs, service issues, and dependencies with various providers. Raise unresolved or material exceptions promptly, while deferring technical judgment and professional decisions to authorized owners. Maintain a provider calendar of key deliverables and contract milestones for CEO visibility. Coordinate Board-cycle logistics, governance calendar, management papers, version control, and action follow-up as directed by the CEO. Support the formally appointed Board Secretary. Coordinate CEO-sponsored projects, partnerships, and product initiatives, tracking milestones and identifying execution bottlenecks. Improve management information, reduce unnecessary reporting, and support approved automation/AI workflows with verification and information-security controls. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. An MBA or relevant master's degree is preferred. 7+ years of total professional experience, with at least 2 years preferably in a CEO Office, Strategy, PMO, Management Consulting, or Executive Coordination role. Experience in the fintech or financial services industry is preferred but not mandatory. Demonstrated experience in executive coordination, contract management, managing outsourced service providers, and cross-departmental coordination. Required Skills Ability to manage relationships with internal departments, external service providers, and business partners. Strong understanding of operational processes, management reporting, and executive support. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Practical experience using AI tools to support work and improve operational efficiency. Strong communication, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. High level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical operational support and coordination within the organization. The role requires close collaboration with the CEO and various internal and external stakeholders. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

da654b3e132c7c75.description: Job description About the Position Galaxy Enterprises Services Co. is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Sales Engineer – Electrical & Chemical to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering field , combined with experience in technical sales, business development, or industrial products . Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers. Identify new business opportunities within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Utilities, Industrial, and Construction sectors. Understand customer technical requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions. Prepare technical and commercial quotations and proposals. Review RFQs, specifications, datasheets, and technical documents. Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain technical and commercial offers. Follow up on quotations, purchase orders, deliveries, and customer requirements. Conduct customer visits and technical discussions when required. Support the Business Development team in achieving sales targets. Monitor market trends, competitors, and potential business opportunities. Ensure proper follow-up with customers from initial inquiry through order completion. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline . 3–7 years of relevant experience in technical sales, business development, or industrial products. Experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Utilities, or Industrial sectors is highly preferred. Good understanding of electrical, chemical, industrial, or MRO products. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to understand technical specifications and convert customer requirements into suitable solutions. Skills Preferred Experience Experience with customers such as Aramco, SEC, SABIC, SATORP, SWCC, MARAFIQ, YASREF , or other major industrial companies will be considered an advantage. Candidates Outside Saudi Arabia Overseas candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates currently residing outside Saudi Arabia with relevant experience are encouraged to submit their CV.

dab3be521c274b88.description: تبحث شركة طواف لخدمات النقل عن سائق حافلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام التام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة والتعليمات التشغيلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنة إلى خمس سنوات في مجال القيادة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفقاً للمسارات والجداول المحددة. الالتزام بأنظمة المرور والسرعات المحددة، والقيادة بسلاسة لتجنب التوقف أو التجاوز المفاجئ. الامتناع التام عن استخدام الهاتف الجوال أثناء القيادة لضمان التركيز والسلامة. إجراء الفحص اليومي للشاحنة قبل الانطلاق، بما في ذلك الفرامل والإطارات والأنوار ومستوى الوقود. التأكد من جاهزية أجهزة السلامة مثل مطفأة الحريق وحقيبة الإسعافات الأولية. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي أعطال ميكانيكية لمركز الصيانة. التقيد بجدول الرحلة ومواعيد التوقف والوصول بدقة. استقبال الركاب بأسلوب مهذب وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم، خاصة كبار السن وذوي الإعاقة. التأكد من مطابقة تذاكر الركاب أو تصاريح الصعود للفئات المصرح لها فقط. الحفاظ على نظافة الحافلة وتشغيل التكييف والإضاءة المناسبة لراحة الركاب. تفقد الحافلة بعد كل رحلة للتأكد من خلوها من الركاب والتعامل مع أي مفقودات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنة إلى خمس سنوات كسائق. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول ( حافلة كبيرة ) . معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بمهنية واحترام. الالتزام بالمواعيد والجدول الزمني للرحلات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة . تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة لضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بكفاءة وأمان. التقديم الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مكة المكرمة.

dafc01e7ffce7c0d.job_title: Outlet Manager, The Club - Fairmont The Red Sea
dafc01e7ffce7c0d.description: Company Description Fairmont Red Sea , positioned in the Kingdom’s groundbreaking Red Sea Project, will provide visitors access to a nature-focused resort. With 361 rooms, eleven distinct dining concepts, including overwater restaurants with views of the Red Sea and the mangroves, and a spa. The resort will be situated next to an 18 hole championship golf course, reflecting Fairmont’s association as a world class golf destination. It will set new standards in sustainable development, positioned on 200km of untouched coastline, an archipelago of more than 90 unspoiled islands, dormant volcanoes, rich marine habitat, and ancient archaeological sites. Job Description Reporting to the F&B Manager, you will be responsible for, but not limited to: Oversee the daily operations of the assigned outlet, ensuring seamless, efficient, and consistent service delivery in line with established operational standards and procedures. Lead, motivate, and supervise the outlet team, ensuring effective scheduling, training, coaching, performance management, and continuous colleague development. Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team culture that promotes colleague engagement, well-being, and excellence. Ensure the highest standards of guest service and satisfaction by consistently implementing and monitoring outlet standards, procedures, and service expectations. Anticipate guest needs and deliver personalized, attentive, and memorable experiences that exceed expectations within a luxury resort environment. Handle guest feedback, requests, and complaints promptly and professionally, taking appropriate action to ensure effective resolution and guest satisfaction. Ensure full compliance with health, safety, hygiene, food safety, environmental standards, and company policies and procedures. Monitor outlet performance, including revenue, labor costs, food and beverage costs, inventory, and other key operational indicators, taking corrective action where required. Manage inventory and procurement processes effectively, ensuring appropriate stock levels, minimizing wastage, and maintaining product quality and consistency. Support the preparation and management of outlet budgets, forecasts, and financial targets, providing accurate and timely reports to senior management. Work closely with Culinary, Front Office, Housekeeping, Stewarding, Engineering, and other hotel departments to ensure seamless operations and an integrated guest experience. Conduct regular briefings and departmental meetings, ensuring clear communication of operational priorities, guest feedback, business updates, and service standards. Monitor colleague performance and provide regular coaching and feedback to drive accountability, engagement, and professional growth. Ensure accurate use of POS and operational systems, maintaining reliable records, reporting, and transaction controls. Maintain comprehensive and accurate documentation related to outlet operations, staffing, inventory, financial performance, and compliance. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service delivery, revenue generation, and guest satisfaction while maintaining high service standards. Support sustainability initiatives and promote responsible use of resources in line with the resort’s environmental and operational objectives. Remain adaptable and resilient in a dynamic luxury resort environment, responding effectively to changing operational requirements while maintaining service excellence. Represent the resort professionally at all times, demonstrating leadership, integrity, discretion, and a genuine passion for hospitality. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, or related field Minimum 4-6 years of progressive experience in outlet management, food and beverage operations, or hospitality management Strong knowledge of health, safety, hygiene, and food safety regulations and best practices Excellent leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and develop staff Exceptional customer service orientation with demonstrated ability to resolve guest concerns professionally Proficiency in hospitality management software and point-of-sale (POS) systems Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English; additional languages preferred Proven Food and Beverage leadership experience with demonstrated success in managing outlet operations Strong proficiency in Microsoft Windows applications and general computer literacy Excellent written and spoken English communication skills Outstanding organizational and time management abilities Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze situations and make decisive decisions Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Ability to remain calm, courteous, and focused on guest needs at all times High level of responsibility, reliability, and professional integrity Demonstrated success in revenue management and cost optimization initiatives Knowledge of inventory management systems and vendor relationship management Additional Information What’s In It For You... The opportunity to join Accor, a leading global hospitality group with an exceptional portfolio of luxury brands. The chance to define the pre-opening operations for two iconic resorts at one of the world’s most anticipated new destinations. Become part of a team dedicated to creating unparalleled luxury hospitality experiences. A competitive package and excellent opportunities for professional growth. Outstanding discounts across the global Accor and luxury brand network.

da0b84b6e573301f.description: About the Role Tencent Cloud Middle East is seeking a Senior Security Operations Engineer to join their team in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time individual contributor role focuses on supporting daily cybersecurity activities, including running established security processes, monitoring and triaging security events, and maintaining compliance documentation. The position involves coordination with central security and compliance teams and is suited for a candidate with 2-5 years of experience looking to advance in cloud security operations and compliance. Key Responsibilities Execute and maintain security operations processes, procedures, and checklists defined by Tencent Cloud's security and compliance teams, tracking tasks and tickets to closure. Monitor security alerts, vulnerabilities, and risk items; perform initial triage, escalate to appropriate owners, and ensure risk and issue trackers are accurate and current. Support incident response activities under guidance, including collecting and preserving evidence, maintaining incident timelines, coordinating with responders, and drafting incident reports and post-incident summaries. Assist with the periodic review and upkeep of cybersecurity and privacy policies, procedures, guidelines, and compliance evidence to ensure documentation remains current and audit-ready. Prepare regular operational reports and dashboards on security posture, open risks, remediation progress, and compliance status for internal stakeholders. Support security awareness activities, internal communications, and the preparation of security documentation and questionnaire responses for customers and partners. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in security operations, IT operations, data security, privacy, or compliance support. Internships and graduate programs are considered. Working knowledge of common security operations tasks, including alert monitoring, vulnerability management, access and entitlement review, log review, and incident documentation. Familiarity with cloud services and common security technologies (*, IAM, network security controls, encryption, SIEM, endpoint protection). Exposure to any major cloud platform is an advantage. Familiarity with information security and privacy standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or PCI DSS. Experience supporting audits or certification activities is a plus. Basic awareness of information security and personal data protection requirements in Saudi Arabia (*, SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, PDPL, NCA controls) and a willingness to build deeper regulatory knowledge on the job. Required Skills Detail-oriented approach to work. Comfortable working with processes, documentation, and cross-team coordination. Entry-level certifications (Security+, CC, ISO 27001 Foundation) are a plus, but not a requirement. Work Environment This role is based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and operates as an individual contributor, focusing on operational execution rather than people management or strategic ownership.

da56616923889328.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Hygiene Officer to join The Ritz-Carlton team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves upholding the "Gold Standards" of The Ritz-Carlton, ensuring exceptional service and operational excellence. The role is integral to maintaining the brand's reputation for luxury hospitality and guest care. Company Overview Marriott International is committed to being an equal opportunity employer, valuing diversity and fostering an inclusive environment. The Ritz-Carlton, with over 100 award-winning properties globally, is renowned for creating memorable guest experiences. da372e7b12fb0a36.description: About Noon Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity. Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here. Learn more about us [here] The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What You Will Do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers. About you (To be successful in this role, you should have): Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment Why Noon? Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day. Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy. AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily. Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating. Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen. Benefits In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer: Performance-based bonus 21 days of annual leave Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent Noon Academy is the #1 EdTech in MENAP, on a mission to radically change the way students learn. Founded in Riyadh in 2013, we've taught over 20 million students across five countries — and today we run Noon Tracks, hybrid micro-schools where a master teacher goes live across up to 20 classrooms at once, amplified by AI and peer-to-peer learning. Never study alone.

The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Deliver insights to improve energy efficiency, resource utilization, and sustainability performance for assigned initiatives. Identify performance gaps and improvement opportunities through data analysis and benchmarking. Establish performance baselines, indicators, and tracking mechanisms for measurable sustainability outcomes. Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and implementation activities to accelerate innovation adoption. Provide technical and economic analysis to strengthen prioritization and investment decisions. Produce accurate dashboards, reports, and performance insights for effective management decisions. Translate complex technical and operational data into practical recommendations and business actions. Advance opportunities to improve sustainability performance, energy efficiency, and resource effectiveness. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices that support operational improvement and sustainability goals. Build effective partnerships across operations, engineering, sustainability, and Technology & Innovation functions. Ensure sustainability activities align with environmental regulations, ESG requirements, and corporate governance standards. Desired Outcomes Sustainability and energy optimization initiatives result in measurable operational and environmental improvements. Data-driven recommendations contribute to improved energy efficiency and resource utilization. Sustainability KPIs are tracked effectively, providing actionable performance insights. Improvement opportunities are identified and implemented to support value creation and operational excellence. Sustainability reporting and project activities consistently meet governance and compliance requirements. Stakeholders are engaged effectively, leading to successful implementation of sustainability initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in sustainability, energy solutions, or a related field. dadf1dca78f48c00.description: About the Role Sabk Aljusore Company is seeking a Heavy Truck Electrician to join its team in Unayzah. This full-time position is within the automotive industry and requires advanced technical skills to manage complex electrical systems in heavy trucks. The role offers an opportunity to enhance technical expertise and engage with modern technologies in a professional setting. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular inspections of heavy truck electrical systems using specialized tools to ensure optimal performance and minimize breakdowns. Diagnose and repair complex electrical faults, utilizing precise measuring equipment such as multimeters and other testing devices. Implement necessary electrical modifications in accordance with customer requirements and industry standards to ensure safety and efficiency. Collaborate with other maintenance teams to identify recurring issues and propose solutions to improve overall maintenance operations. Provide technical support and guidance to new employees, facilitating their integration and fostering a culture of continuous learning. Develop detailed reports on completed work and repaired faults to aid in the improvement of future operations. Monitor the performance of electrical systems and offer recommendations for improvement, contributing to increased efficiency and reduced costs. Update technical knowledge on the latest developments in heavy truck technology to ensure the delivery of high-quality services. Interact with clients to understand their needs and requirements, contributing to building long-term relationships and achieving customer satisfaction. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in heavy truck electrical systems. Proficiency in using specialized tools and precise measuring equipment for electrical diagnostics and repair. Strong understanding of industry standards and safety protocols related to heavy truck electrical modifications. Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment. Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on technological advancements. Work Environment This role is part of a dynamic team focused on collaboration and continuous learning. Employees are encouraged to exchange knowledge and experiences, and participate in workshops and training courses to enhance technical and managerial skills. The company fosters a positive and supportive work environment to achieve individual and collective success. Application Process Individuals passionate about electrical technology and committed to achieving tangible results are encouraged to apply for this opportunity to contribute to the heavy truck industry.

da064a518f3b6a38.description: Job summary: We are seeking a skilled SRE Engineer and Observability to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Elasticsearch and observability solutions, with the ability to configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Elastic environments. This role requires expertise in deploying and managing clusters, developing search solutions, and optimizing performance. Key Responsibilities: Monitoring & Observability -Design, deploy, and manage monitoring/observability stacks (Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Zabbix) -Build custom dashboards and KPIs tracking system health, app performance, SLIs/SLOs -Implement proactive alerting; create and automate alert rules -Install, configure, and troubleshoot Elasticsearch clusters; design ETL pipelines and index templates -Define metrics, logs, and traces for new services with dev teams Automation & Infrastructure: -Automate monitoring/alerting config via IaC (Terraform) -Create and Manage CI/CD pipelines -Manage Linux, Kubernetes/Docker, and cloud infra (OCI/GCP/Azure) -Maintain inventory and documentation of deployments Incident Response -On-call rotations, post-incident reviews, runbook/playbook development -Provide telemetry-driven root cause analysis Collaboration -Partner with Dev/QA/Ops to ensure services are properly instrumented -Train internal teams on dashboards and metrics interpretation Requirements: -Bachelor’s in CS, Engineering, or related (or equivalent experience) -3–5 years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering -Strong hands-on experience with Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) plus Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog -Proficient in Linux, networking, SQL, regex, scripting -Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and cloud platforms (OCI/GCP/Azure) -Logging/tracing/metrics best practices -APM and basic ML-based anomaly detection exposure a plus -Certified Elastic Engineer a plus -Willing to travel to KSA as required

da73830ded936076.description: ARX is a global network of specialists in engineering, design, and architecture. Our team offers 360° consulting, project management, and technical services in: airports, bridges, buildings, cableways, digital innovation, environment, equipment, geology, geotechnics, hydropower, metros, nuclear plants, oil & gas, pipelines, ports, railways, river engineering, roads, traffic, tunnels, and water/wastewater treatment. With offices across Europe, North and South America, Asia, Africa, and Oceania, our agile task force combines global expertise with local know-how. The result is our uniquely "glocal" approach, which allows us to meet the specific needs of each community while incorporating international best practices. At ARX, smart minds strive for a sustainable future, transforming communities one innovative project at a time. People are the heart and soul of ARX. We are a home for innovators, visionaries, and experts to develop talents, launch careers, and collaborate with fellow specialists. ARX values individuals. Believing their brilliance and determination will provide solutions to tomorrow's challenges, we welcome professionals who will both benefit from and enrich our team. ARX, marks a significant expansion into the Middle East with our offices in UAE and KSA. This establishment underscores our dedication to innovation and engineering excellence, bolstering our position in the dynamic GCC market. For our office in Riyadh, we are looking for Senior Design Manager - 100% (m/f) The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 12 years' experience in design management, engineering management, or multidisciplinary technical delivery, including at least 5 years in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will have led complex infrastructure, transport, buildings, or mixed-use design assignments from concept through detailed design, tender support, construction-stage design, and close-out. The role calls for sound technical judgement, confidence in front of clients, strong interface management, commercial awareness, and the ability to hold a multidisciplinary team to programme, quality, and compliance without losing design value. The Design Manager owns the technical integrity and coordination of the design; commercial and contractual accountability for the assignment sits with the Project Manager. Responsibilities: Lead the multidisciplinary design team (civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and specialist systems) and own the technical coherence of the design across disciplines. Own design delivery through every stage: concept, schematic, detailed design, tender documentation, IFC issue, construction support, and technical close-out. Act as the client's principal technical counterpart on design matters, and coordinate subconsultants, contractors, suppliers, and Saudi authorities. Review and approve design deliverables before issue, testing them for technical accuracy, constructability, Saudi Building Code (SBC) compliance, and alignment with the employer's requirements. Chair design coordination meetings, interdisciplinary workshops, and comment-resolution reviews, and drive each to a documented decision. Drive design comments, RFIs, technical queries, and design changes through to formal closure, keeping the audit trail intact. Identify and mitigate design risk early (interface, constructability, authority approval, and programme risk) and escalate what cannot be closed at design level. Set the standard for BIM-enabled delivery: model-based interface checks, clash review, and disciplined CDE workflows. Work with the Project Manager and the planning and commercial teams so that design progress, programme, and fee expenditure stay aligned. Apply and enforce ARX's QA/QC regime (review checklists, design verification, and lessons learned) so that quality is built in rather than inspected in. Lead value engineering and technical option studies, including low-carbon and whole-life performance improvements aligned with Saudi Green Building Code and Vision 2030 sustainability targets, and quantify the benefit of each. Forecast design resource needs, allocate workload across the team, and mentor engineers within the design stream. Report design progress, risk, and interface status to ARX management and to the client, in writing and in person. Contribute to proposals, design delivery strategies, technical methodologies, and fee estimates for new opportunities. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 12 years' relevant experience in design management, engineering management, or multidisciplinary design coordination, of which at least 5 in a lead design management role. Minimum 5 years of KSA experience is required, including direct exposure to Saudi authority approval processes such as MOMRAH / Balady, Saudi Civil Defense, the Royal Commission for Riyadh City (RCRC), the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services, or the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu, as well as giga-project client approval frameworks. Proven experience leading design on complex infrastructure, transport, buildings, or mixed-use assignments. Strong command of design-stage gateways, deliverable definition, design verification, and construction-stage design support. Solid knowledge of the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and KSA authority requirements alongside international standards such as BS, EN, AASHTO, or ASHRAE. Experience with BIM-enabled design coordination and CDE / document-control platforms such as ACONEX, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or SharePoint. Commercial and programme awareness, including design-change control, fee monitoring, and the schedule impact of design decisions. Ability to lead a team, earn client trust, and hold delivery discipline under competing priorities in a lean consulting environment. Excellent written and verbal English is required; Arabic language capability is a strong advantage. Chartered status (CEng, PE, or equivalent) or professional membership of ICE, IStructE, RIBA, or CIOB is preferred; PMP is an advantage. Professional accreditation with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), or eligibility to obtain it, is required. We Offer: Opportunity to collaborate with a forward-thinking, synergistic, and innovative team. Exposure to cutting-edge projects driving Middle East / North African regions development. Personalized professional growth and developmental avenues tailored to your career aspirations. If you would you like to join our highly motivated and very successful team please send us your complete application! Sector: Construction / Civil Engineering Role: Engineering / Design Engineering Job type: Permanent job

dad8fcb655a1541f.job_title: Senior Business Continuity Management Consultant (Arabic Speaking)
dad8fcb655a1541f.description: Inbox Business Technologies is seeking an experienced, Arabic-speaking Senior BCM Consultant to lead business continuity workstreams for a regulated telecommunications infrastructure client in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The engagement involves reviewing and refreshing a mature BCM program: updating governance documentation, validating the Business Impact Analysis (BIA) methodology, executing the BIA across multiple business sectors, developing sector-level Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), and aligning the wider BCM documentation set with the Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST) Business Continuity Management Regulations and ISO 22301. Employment Type: Full-time employment Key Responsibilities BIA facilitation: lead BIA introductory sessions, facilitation clinics and validation workshops with business sector representatives; review, challenge and validate departmental submissions; consolidate results to identify critical processes, recovery objectives (RTO, RPO, MAO), dependencies and single points of failure. Business continuity planning: run recovery strategy workshops and develop sector-level BCPs on the client's templates, covering roles, activation and escalation protocols, recovery procedures and communications. Governance and methodology: contribute to gap assessments of the BCM Framework and BIA methodology against ISO 22301, CST BCM regulatory requirements and regulator audit findings; draft tracked-change updates and compliance traceability matrices. Artefact alignment: review and update crisis management and communication plans, emergency response plans, IT DR plan templates and regulator readiness response templates (e.g. Hajj and Ramadan) for consistency with the updated framework and plans. Exercising and training: design and facilitate role-based BCM training and tabletop exercises and prepare post-exercise reports with remediation actions. Stakeholder engagement: work directly with sector heads, process owners, BC coordinators and the client's BCM function; build ownership so that plans are used by the business after handover. Quality and reporting: ensure deliverables meet agreed acceptance criteria at first submission; contribute to weekly status reports and steering committee materials. Bid support: participate in client presentations and team assessment interviews as a proposed named team member. Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Information Technology, Risk Management or a related field. Minimum 6–8 years of BCM experience, including hands-on delivery of BIAs and BCPs end to end. Recognized business continuity certification, such as BCI CBCI / MBCI, DRII CBCP / MBCP, or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer. Business-level fluency in Arabic and English (spoken and written), with the ability to facilitate workshops in either language. Proven experience delivering BCM engagements in regulated telecommunications or critical infrastructure environments in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working knowledge of the CST Business Continuity Management Regulations and ISO 22301, ISO 22313 and ISO/TS 22317. Strong workshop facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders. Excellent report-writing skills, including policy, methodology and plan documentation. Available to work for the full duration of the engagement. Experience addressing regulator audit findings and BCM maturity assessments in KSA. Experience with crisis management, emergency response and IT disaster recovery documentation. Experience designing and facilitating tabletop exercises (ISO 22398). Familiarity with enterprise risk management frameworks and aligning BIA impact scales with ERM. Additional certifications such as ISO 22301 Lead Auditor, CRISC or PMP. Structured, analytical thinking with attention to detail and consistency. Ability to challenge business inputs constructively and drive decisions. Ownership of quality and deadlines in a fast-paced, fixed-schedule engagement. Cultural awareness and professional presence in client-facing settings. Team player who can coach junior consultants and work with remote support staff.

da05c3217a2dbcad.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company with over 400 employees, dedicated to business communication solutions for more than 5000 customer-centric companies. The company fosters a collaborative work environment and is recognized as a Great Place to Work®. Employees are shareholders in the business. The Role of Product Manager - Data & Insights Unifonic is seeking a Product Manager - Data & Insights to lead the development of customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, requires 5-10 years of experience and involves managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities, from research and data modeling to delivery and continuous improvement. The Product Manager will collaborate with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem and champion data compliance across all Unifonic products. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Advise other Product teams on data strategy and design. Collect business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders. Develop detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partner with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (*, Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and its impact on performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around ETL/ELT processes and dimensional modeling. Own and enforce data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Define processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection. Advocate for data accuracy and identify misleading or incomplete insights. Own the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (*, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Define self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to improve dashboard usability and relevance. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines. Required Qualifications and Skills Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights. Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively. AI Proficiency and Character Traits Candidates should demonstrate a minimum of L4 (Proficient) AI proficiency, applying AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. This includes using AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping while personally owning the accuracy of every output. Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable is expected, along with the ability to write structured prompts and refine them. The role requires synthesizing insights from various sources, drafting documents with AI as a first-draft partner, and building clickable prototypes. Understanding AI agent construction and identifying automation workflows, as well as flagging AI risks, are also essential. Key character traits for this role include analytical thinking, problem-solving, ownership, accountability, clear communication, collaboration, adaptability, continuous learning, mentorship, knowledge sharing, resilience, a focus on quality and attention to detail, and advocacy for innovation and best practices.

da075a7bb25f9849.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجارة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة والتركيب والإصلاح لأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف بكفاءة عالية، مع ضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بأنظمة التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية في المواقع المحددة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الروتين الصباحي اليومي لضمان جاهزية الموقع في مجال الاختصاص. التأكد من اكتمال تنفيذ الأعمال من قبل الفنيين وإغلاق أوامر العمل بشكل صحيح. مراجعة المستفيدين للتأكد من جودة الأعمال المنفذة ورضاهم عنها. تركيب وتشغيل وإصلاح أنظمة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف، بما في ذلك جميع أنواع وحدات التكييف ومراوح السحب ومعدات التدفئة، وفقاً للمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء فحوصات دورية لأنظمة التكييف والتهوية والتدفئة حسب برنامج الصيانة اليومية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ الصيانة الطارئة والتصحيحية. تشغيل واختبار الأنظمة بعد التركيب لضمان عملها بشكل سليم وفعال. ضمان أن جميع أعمال التركيب والصيانة الطارئة والتصحيحية والتشغيل والاختبار تتم وفقاً لمعايير السلامة والجودة المعتمدة. تشخيص الأعطال وتقييم كفاءة الأنظمة باستخدام أدوات القياس والفحص المتخصصة. القيام بأي أعمال أخرى ذات صلة بهذا المجال أو أي مهام أخرى توكل إليه ضمن نطاق مصلحة المشروع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. معرفة قوية بأنظمة التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية المختلفة ومكوناتها. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتطبيقها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على استخدام أدوات القياس والفحص المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأعمال. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع الفنيين والمستفيدين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

da14987891ed2b2a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة قمم الرازن للسلامة عن أخصائي مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقييم احتياجات ومتطلبات الوحدات التنظيمية من المواد، والبحث في السوق للحصول على أفضل أسعار الشراء، والإشراف على عروض الموردين وتقييمها، بالإضافة إلى بناء قاعدة بيانات للمواد والموردين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم احتياجات ومتطلبات الوحدات التنظيمية المختلفة من المواد وتحديد أولويات الشراء بناءً على ذلك. إجراء دراسات وتحليلات متخصصة ومسح للسوق بهدف الوصول إلى أفضل أسعار الشراء من الموردين وضمان الجودة المطلوبة للمواد وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على عمليات وإجراءات استلام العروض من موردي الخدمات وتقييمها بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الإدارية الأخرى، مع ضمان مطابقتها للإجراءات المعتمدة. بناء قاعدة بيانات لأسعار المواد المستهلكة بصورة متكررة وأهم الموردين لها، والاحتفاظ بملفات متكاملة عن عمليات الشراء المختلفة وفقاً للنظام المعتمد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتحديد أولويات الشراء. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وتحليل السوق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم نحن ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مؤسسة قمم الرازن للسلامة.

da1ee1a1a171a19e.description: About the Role Noble Horizon is seeking a Sales Executive for Merchant Acquisition & Deals. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on expanding the merchant network for a deals application. The application connects customers with various offers across sectors including F&B, hospitality, wellness, leisure, and other services. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to acquire new merchants, sell subscription packages, and secure compelling offers. The Sales Executive will be responsible for creating value for both merchant partners and the application's users by ensuring attractive deals are available. Key Responsibilities Identify and approach potential merchant partners through prospecting, cold calls, networking, and face-to-face meetings. Present the application’s value proposition and sell merchant subscription packages. Negotiate commercial terms and compelling deals with various businesses, including restaurants, cafés, hotels, salons, spas, leisure venues, and service providers. Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and proposal development to closing deals and merchant onboarding. Build strong relationships with merchants to support renewals and ongoing participation. Maintain accurate CRM records, provide pipeline updates, and meet targets for merchant acquisition and subscription revenue. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure offers are accurate, published on time, and easily redeemable by customers. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in sales, particularly in merchant acquisition or a related field. Work Type This is a full-time position. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

da2f9aea65d31d22.description: About the Role Kerten Hospitality is seeking an IT Assistant to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role involves providing essential technical support to hotel staff and guests, ensuring the smooth operation of IT infrastructure and systems at The House Hotel Jeddah. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. About Kerten Hospitality Kerten Hospitality (KH) operates as an end-to-end lifestyle hospitality provider, focusing on creating bespoke destinations, lodging, experiences, and communities. The company aims to optimize operations and drive profitability for investors while maintaining a commitment to sustainability. KH develops destinations through partnerships across lodging, food & beverage, retail, entertainment, art, and wellness brands, with a focus on building ecosystems and community-centric destinations that connect international and local travelers. The group's current pipeline includes over 55 lodging projects, representing more than 4,500 keys across the Middle East, Europe, and North Africa. Responsibilities Provide first-line technical support to hotel staff, addressing IT requests and resolving hardware, software, and network issues. Assist in maintaining the hotel's IT infrastructure, including computers, printers, phones, Wi-Fi, and network equipment. Support the daily operation of hotel systems such as PMS, POS, and other business applications, escalating complex issues to the IT Manager or vendors. Install, configure, and update computers, devices, and software in accordance with company standards. Assist with routine backups, antivirus updates, and security checks to protect hotel systems and data. Maintain accurate records of IT assets, support tickets, and maintenance activities. Set up IT equipment for meetings, conferences, and events, and support guests with in-room technology and internet access as needed. Assist with system upgrades, technology projects, and the setup of new users and devices. Adhere to company IT policies and security standards, and help train staff on basic system use and best practices. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in IT support or a related field. Ability to provide technical assistance and resolve common IT issues. Familiarity with hardware, software, and network troubleshooting. Understanding of IT infrastructure components and business applications. Benefits Competitive Compensation: A rewarding package based on experience. Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within the organization. Inclusive Environment: A workplace that encourages collaboration. Shared Purpose: Working with individuals who uphold the company's values of connection, innovation, curation, and leadership. Location This position is based at The House Hotel Jeddah King Road, located in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Jeddah is a dynamic city on the Red Sea coastline, offering a blend of coastal lifestyle, culture, and modern living. The city is well-connected through King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED).

da6cf2eae52639a6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مجمع بدر الشهداء الطبي عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بدر، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم العمليات المخبرية الأساسية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقًا لنوع الفحص المطلوب ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز، مع تدوين بيانات المرضى عليها وحفظها بالطرق الصحيحة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة، وإجراء الفحوصات المختلفة بما في ذلك التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج النتائج وتوثيقها بدقة، والتخلص من العينات بعد الانتهاء من الفحوصات مع توثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعدات المخبرية وتشغيلها بكفاءة. معرفة بأسس حفظ العينات وإجراءات السلامة المخبرية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المختبر الطبي ضمن فريق شركة مجمع بدر الشهداء الطبي في مدينة بدر بالمدينة المنورة، في بيئة عمل متخصصة تدعم تقديم الخدمات الطبية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمرشحين لتطوير مهاراتهم في بيئة رعاية صحية ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

da835b0cb6d23067.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking an Instrumentation & Control Technician to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves carrying out maintenance, installation, overhauling, and modification activities on the plant's instrumentation and control systems and equipment. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform routine preventative instrumentation and control maintenance according to schedule and procedures to ensure continuous operations. Monitor the physical condition of systems and equipment in the assigned plant and report non-conformances to the Instrumentation and Control Supervisor. Respond to instrumentation and control failures, implementing corrective actions to reduce downtime and maximize equipment functionality. Troubleshoot malfunctions using necessary tools and spare parts, including diagnosis, dismantling, repair, part changes, checking, cleaning, and reassembly to ensure instruments are calibrated and in good working condition. Diagnose causes of malfunction or failure of operational equipment such as control valves and transmitters, taking corrective measures in collaboration with the supervisor. Read and interpret technical manuals, control diagrams, and system diagrams to perform maintenance and troubleshooting tasks. Documentation and Continuous Improvement Update the maintenance logbook with details of work carried out, including defaults, problems, findings, and conditions of all instrumentation and control systems. Contribute to the identification and implementation of change initiatives, programs, and projects in line with organizational standards. Compliance and Safety Adhere to all relevant organizational and departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Comply with all health, safety, security, and environmental procedures, instructions, and controls to ensure employee safety and environmental compliance. Working Relationships The Instrumentation & Control Technician will work closely with the Instrumentation & Control Supervisor, Engineers, and Supervisors within the Maintenance section, as well as the Operations Team. Additional Duties Perform any other duties as required by the line manager.

dac65614c1eb94ad.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking a Business Development Manager — Offshore to lead the expansion of its offshore energy portfolio in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in the Eastern Province, covering Al Khobar and Dhahran. The primary focus of this role is to secure scopes within Saudi Aramco's Offshore Maintain Potential Program (MPP), with a secondary focus on offshore and marine programs from the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services and Mawani. The successful candidate will manage the complete business development cycle, from market intelligence and client engagement to opportunity qualification, proposal leadership, commercial negotiation, and contract handover. This involves converting Front End's exclusive partnerships, particularly with Acteon, into pre-qualifications, Long Term Agreements (LTAs), and awarded projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a capture plan for Aramco's Offshore MPP work scopes, including platform tie-ins, jackets and decks, MOPU installations, subsea pipeline replacements, brownfield modifications, and platform life-extension campaigns. Map MPP stakeholders across Aramco's Offshore Projects Department, Northern Area Oil Operations (NAOO), Upstream Engineering Services, Marine Department, and Procurement & Supply Chain Management (P&SCM), building relationships at decision-making levels. Track MPP package releases, EPCI tender cycles, and IKTVA expectations, positioning Front End and alliance partners for prequalification (9COM, SAP Ariba), technical evaluation, and award. Lead pursuit strategies for Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and call-off scopes under Aramco's offshore framework contracts for services such as survey, positioning, mooring, foundations, inspection, IRM, and decommissioning. Drive business development for Mawani-led offshore and nearshore programs, including port expansions, marine infrastructure upgrades, dredging support, hydrographic and geophysical surveys, mooring systems, quay-wall and breakwater works, and offshore aids-to-navigation. Engage the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services on national maritime initiatives aligned with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS) and Saudi Vision 2030. Pursue framework agreements, LTAs, and project-specific tenders issued by Mawani and its operating partners. Manage the offshore opportunity pipeline in CRM, forecasting bookings, revenue, and gross margin by program. Lead bid strategy, win themes, pricing posture, and risk allocation in collaboration with Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams. Oversee proposal development with Front End's proposals team and alliance partners to ensure compliant and competitive submissions. Negotiate LTAs, master service agreements, and call-off contracts, ensuring smooth handover to Project Delivery. Maintain a structured view of Saudi Arabia's offshore market, including Aramco offshore CAPEX/OPEX, Mawani port master plan, and Red Sea/NEOM coastal developments. Monitor competitor activity and integrate insights into positioning and pricing strategy. Identify opportunities for new alliances, technology transfer, and localization to enhance IKTVA scores. Act as Front End's primary commercial interface with offshore alliance partners, coordinating joint pursuits, technical workshops, and client visits. Represent Front End at industry events such as ADIPEC, Saudi Maritime Congress, Aramco supplier forums, and Mawani industry days. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Petroleum, Marine, Civil/Structural, or Subsea), Geoscience, or a related technical discipline. An MBA is an advantage. 8–12 years of business development or commercial experience in the offshore oil & gas or marine sector, with at least 4 years of sales experience in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated success in closing offshore scopes with Saudi Aramco and/or Mawani / MoT, evidenced by named awards, LTAs, or framework agreements. Strong working knowledge of Aramco's prequalification process (9COM, SAP Ariba, IKTVA), contracting strategies, and offshore technical standards (SAES, SAEP, SAMSS). Familiarity with Mawani tendering and Ministry of Transport procurement processes. Hands-on experience leading complex offshore proposals (EPCI, IRM, survey, mooring, foundations, decommissioning) typically above USD 10 million. Commercial acumen across pricing, contract terms (FIDIC, LOGIC, bespoke Aramco/Mawani forms), risk allocation, and consortium structuring. Preferred Qualifications Candidates with direct familiarity with Saudi Aramco Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and the Offshore Maintain Potential Program will receive higher consideration. This includes evidence of: Previous business development or account-management ownership of an Aramco offshore LTA (survey, mooring, foundations, IRM, or marine construction support), including call-off generation, scope expansion, and renewal. Direct involvement in Maintain Potential Program offshore campaigns such as tie-ins, MOPU/jacket installations, brownfield modifications, pipeline replacements, or platform life-extension work. An established network within Aramco Offshore Projects, NAOO, Marine Department, and the contracting community supporting MPP. A track record of structuring consortium or alliance bids that meet Aramco IKTVA and Saudization requirements. Work Type and Experience This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

dacd7d6fb6af0d6d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن فني شبكات اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التشغيل السلس لشبكات الاتصالات، بما في ذلك الهواتف والإنترنت، من خلال تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات وصيانتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات اللازمة لتشغيل الشبكات. ضمان تشغيل خدمات الهواتف والإنترنت بكفاءة. توصيل كافة الأسلاك داخل المباني وخارجها. إعداد تقارير دورية للمسؤول المباشر حول حالة الشبكات والأعمال المنجزة. المهام التشغيلية تطبيق المعرفة بأنظمة الإرسال والبث والتبديل والتحكم في الاتصالات. متابعة مشكلات الشبكة والعمل على حلها تحت إشراف مهندس الشبكة. إجراء الصيانة الروتينية لمعدات وأدوات الاتصالات وتحديد نوع الصيانة اللازمة وتوقيتها. اختبار المعدات التي تم إصلاحها أو تثبيتها حديثًا أو تحديثها للتأكد من عملها بشكل صحيح ومطابقتها للمواصفات. اختبار الدوائر ومكونات معدات الاتصالات السلكية واللاسلكية المعطلة لتحديد مصادر الأعطال وإصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال شبكات الاتصالات. فهم قوي لمبادئ تشغيل أنظمة الاتصالات. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني شبكات الاتصالات بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى الحفاظ على استمرارية وكفاءة خدمات الاتصالات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

daeec69d9ad21534.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ارتكاز الحديث عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في تنفيذ المشروعات الهندسية من خلال توفير الدعم الفني والتقني اللازم للفرق الهندسية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنسيق الرسومات الهندسية والوثائق الفنية للمشروعات. متابعة تطورات المشروعات وتحديث الرسومات والوثائق حسب الحاجة. تجهيز المستندات والتقارير الفنية المطلوبة لتنفيذ وإدارة المشروعات. مراجعة وفحص الرسومات والمستندات لضمان الدقة والتناسق. التنسيق مع فرق الهندسة والإنتاج لضمان توافق الأعمال مع المواصفات. إعداد جداول زمنية ومخططات لتنفيذ المشروعات. التعامل مع برامج الحاسوب الهندسية والبرمجيات المكتبية ذات الصلة. مساعدة الفرق الهندسية في حساب الكميات والتكاليف وتقديرات المشروع. تنسيق اجتماعات وجلسات عمل بين فرق العمل المختلفة. مراجعة الطلبيات والمواصفات ومتطلبات المشروعات. متابعة تطورات سير العمل وإبلاغ الإدارة بالتحديثات اللازمة. الاحتفاظ بسجلات دقيقة لكل مرحلة من مراحل المشروع والتغييرات. التأكد من التوافق مع اللوائح الحكومية ولوائح البناء. تقديم الدعم للمهندسين وفرق العمل الأخرى والرد على استفساراتهم. الدعم الإداري تنفيذ السياسات والإجراءات الخاصة بالإدارة. تنفيذ المبادرات والمشاريع الخاصة بالإدارة. إعداد التقارير الدورية الخاصة بنشاط الإدارة. تقديم الدعم اللازم للرئيس المباشر، والقيام بأي مهام أخرى تسند له في اختصاصه. القيام بأي مهام إدارية أخرى ذات صلة حسب الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد وتنسيق الرسومات الهندسية والوثائق الفنية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب الهندسية والبرمجيات المكتبية ذات الصلة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق في بيئة عمل داعمة في الرياض، ويسهم بشكل مباشر في نجاح المشروعات الهندسية للشركة. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.
